rows.text: You pass by a habitat filled by a massive Swarm. A giant Lord of Eternal Slumber is sleeping soundly on a putrefied throne.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: The Lord of Eternal Slumber has both its eyes closed. It seems to be lost in its dreams.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You check the map in your hand... and find that your way ahead is blocked! As you are about to take a detour, you notice some newly born *spores* gathering around the Lord of Eternal Slumber. A daring idea blossoms in your mind...
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
